profile_text.body:
Everway, formerly n2y and Texthelp, describes itself as a company that breaks down barriers to learning and work with advanced technology. Per its own site, it supports daily tasks such as reading, writing, planning and communication, and says its products are shaped by research, lived experience and feedback from its community. It offers instruction tools that give teachers resources for differentiated learning, and assistive tools meant to help individuals in the classroom, at college and in the workplace. The site says its tools support learners from early years to higher education, make reading, writing and learning more accessible, and help teachers build neuroinclusive classrooms, and that it helps organizations create workplaces that support many ways of thinking.

Its tracked product is Read&Write by Texthelp, listed under Education & Research AI. The note describes it as using AI for text-to-speech, prediction and translation, aimed at students and teachers. It is deployed by the school, which accepts the license terms on students' behalf. The company is a Student Privacy Pledge signatory and has many signed district agreements in the SDPC registry. Premium access is free for K-12 teachers, while student seats are priced per year with the amount on quote. The site also names ULS, Inspire, News2you, Positivity, Classics, SymbolStix, Prime, L3 Skills, Polaris, Read&Write, OrbitNote, Equatio, Global Tasks, WritingHelper, ClaroRead, uPar and AutoCorrect.
